ideas.details: Revamp category terminology for supernatural powers and rituals using systematic '-mancy' thematic naming (e.g., Hemomancy for Blood Magic/Vitae Arts, Osteomancy for Bone Magic/Necromancy/Grave Arts, Psychomancy for Mental/Illusion Powers, Umbmancy/Shadowmancy for Shadow/Abyssal Arts). Normalize all power category headers and cross-references across core ruleset and supplements once red team audits and active TODO tasks are complete.
